title: fix(playwright): browser.start HEADFUL dumps core where the sandbox cannot init or no display exists
description:
## .what

`browser.start --mode HEADFUL` dumps core on a host that restricts unprivileged user namespaces (Ubuntu
24.04 default) and on a host with no display. it fails as a bare MalfunctionError at `:237`, with
chromium's own stderr sent to /dev/null, so the cause is invisible.

## .repro

- host: kernel 6.8.0 (ubuntu), `/proc/sys/kernel/apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns` = `1`, a tty
  session with `DISPLAY` empty
- `rhx browser.start --mode HEADFUL --session x` → `Trace/breakpoint trap (core dumped)` at `:149`,
  then `MalfunctionError: command failed · line: 237`
- same, with an Xvfb display on `:99` and `DISPLAY=:99` → the same trap. so the display is not the
  only gap

## .root cause (read)

- `browser.start.sh:220-227`: the skill's own comment says chrome aborts (core dumped) without
  `--no-sandbox` and `--disable-dev-shm-usage`, and it passes them only in HEADLESS (`:231`). HEADFUL
  (`:233`) passes neither
- with `apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1`, chromium's namespace sandbox cannot init for an
  unprivileged user, so HEADFUL traps where HEADLESS (with `--no-sandbox`) does not
- the skill never checks `DISPLAY`, so a display-less host also traps with no hint

## .the shape of the fix

- HEADFUL takes the same sandbox flags when the sandbox cannot init (detect the userns restriction,
  or try with the sandbox and fall back), and says which it chose
- check `DISPLAY` / `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` before launch; absent → a ConstraintError that names the fix
  (e.g. run under Xvfb, `xvfb-run`, or a display)
- send chromium's stderr to a log file the error names, never /dev/null
- clamps: a launch test under a restricted-userns host (or with the sandbox forced to fail), and one
  with `DISPLAY` unset; red before, green after

## .see also

- #40 (the playwright lookup defect, same skill)
